format: onnx (2 inputs: 'obs' [1,167] and 'obs_history' [1,10,167]; output 'actions' [1,29]); .pt = rsl_rl training checkpoint (state dict)

action.meaning: joint pos offset -> PD target q* = default + scale * clip(a)
action.notes: scale = 0.25*effort_limit/kp (mjlab G1_ACTION_SCALE; g1.yaml:2,27-31). Deploy uses MuJoCo built-in position actuators (gainprm=kp, biasprm=[0,-kp,-kd]) stepped 4x at 200 Hz; training clip is none (mjlab JointPositionAction), the [-10,10] clip is deploy-only.

terms.name: ref_joint_pos
terms.history: current frame in 'obs'; also in obs_history
terms.frame: joint space (absolute ref joint angles, NOT minus default)

terms.name: ref_joint_vel
terms.frame: joint space; deploy = finite diff of consecutive retargeted ref joint pos * policy_hz (zeros on first step); training uses motion-file joint_vel

terms.name: ref_anchor_ori_b
terms.frame: body (robot torso_link); rot6d of R = R(robot_torso)^T R(ref_torso), first two COLUMNS flattened row-major: [r00,r01,r10,r11,r20,r21]

terms.name: robot_joint_pos_rel
terms.noise: U(-0.01,0.01) in training (+ startup default-pos DR +-0.01)

terms.name: robot_joint_vel
terms.frame: joint space, raw qvel (no 0.05 scale despite dof_vel_scale in g1.yaml:55 - that field is unused by this builder)

terms.name: prev_action
terms.frame: raw network output of previous step (before clip/scale)

terms.name: ref_anchor_lin_vel_b
terms.frame: ref torso_link world lin vel rotated into ROBOT torso_link frame (full 3D rotation); deploy = finite diff of FK torso position between consecutive policy steps

terms.name: ref_anchor_ang_vel_b
terms.frame: ref torso_link world ang vel rotated into ROBOT torso_link frame; deploy = axis-angle of q_cur*q_prev^-1 / dt

terms.name: ref_anchor_height
terms.frame: world z of reference torso_link (m), from FK of yaw-aligned ref root+joints

obs.history_layout: oldest-first: 'obs_history' [1,10,167] is a deque of the last 10 full 167-D obs frames INCLUDING the current one as the last row; on first call/reset it is filled with 10 copies of the first obs. 'obs' = the current 167-D frame. Training: mjlab ObservationGroup history_length=10, flatten_history_dim=False.
obs.normalization: running mean/std (rsl_rl EmpiricalNormalization) for both 'obs' and 'obs_history' is baked into the ONNX graph; feed raw values

reference.type: root+joints (single current frame: 7-D root pose wxyz + 29 joint angles; policy derives torso anchor via FK)
reference.includes_root: rot yes (torso orientation relative to robot, ref gravity), height yes (ref torso z world), lin/ang vel yes (ref torso, in robot torso frame); root xy position NOT observed (ref_anchor_pos_b removed, env.py:264-268)
reference.coordinate frame: reference qpos is yaw-aligned once at start: fixed yaw offset = yaw(robot_quat * ref_quat^-1) about pivot = first ref root pos, optional xy offset; then FK on the policy's own MJCF (torso_link). Quaternions wxyz.
reference.motion_file_format: training: NPZ with keys fps, root_pos, root_quat_w (wxyz), joint_pos, joint_vel, body_pos_w, body_quat_w, body_lin_vel_w, body_ang_vel_w, body_names (train_mimic/data/dataset_lib.py:15-26), precomputed to HDF5 shards; LAFAN1 resampled to 30 fps (train_mimic/configs/datasets/lafan1.yaml:2). Deploy: BVH (lafan1/hc_mocap/etc.) retargeted online by bundled GMR, linearly interpolated (root slerp) to 50 Hz (teleopit/sim/reference_motion.py:154-182).

inputs_supported: ARMS mode (upper body from mocap, lower body held)
how_they_run_it: MuJoCo sim at 200 Hz (dt 0.005, newton/implicitfast, 10 iters / 20 ls iters) with built-in PD position actuators set from kp/kd; policy at 50 Hz (decimation 4). Each policy step (teleopit/sim/session.py:652-721): read robot state (joint qpos/qvel, pelvis quat, gyro at imu_in_pelvis); retarget the current human frame to a 36-D G1 qpos (offline BVH: retarget each source frame, interpolate at policy time); yaw-align the reference to the robot's heading (fixed at the first step); compute ref joint vel by finite difference vs previous ref (x50) and ref torso lin/ang vel by FK finite difference; build the 167-D obs (base 154-D + velcmd 13-D); push into a 10-frame history deque; run ONNX(obs, obs_history); target = default + action_scale * clip(action,-10,10); set ctrl and step MuJoCo 4 times; store raw action as prev_action. Robot initialised at mujoco_default_qpos (pelvis z 0.76, default joints).
open_questions: ONNX input names/shapes (obs [1,167], obs_history [1,10,167]) are inferred from the export/deploy code, not read from the file: confirm in static inspection (onnx graph inputs + any metadata_props).

Joint order is the MJCF/actuator order of g1_29dof.xml (constants.py:9-11 states it is the canonical policy order); mjlab training resolves actuators by regex '.*' in entity order - assumed identical to XML order.

Training ref_joint_vel / anchor velocities come from the motion file (30 fps data interpolated) while deploy uses 50 Hz finite differences; our runner should use the deploy convention (finite diff at 50 Hz) for parity with their sim2sim.
Whether track_g1_neck_o6 was trained with --robot_xml g1_29dof_neck_o6.xml (inertia differs) is not recorded in code; README/CHANGELOG only say it must be paired with that XML.
Ref anchor height is world z of the ref torso; the LAFAN1 G1 csv root height must match the policy's ground plane (Teleopit preprocess uses normalize_root_xy and ground_align none for lafan1).
runtime.velocity_limit is null: no velocity limit found in repo code.
Teleopit's anchor terms are torso_link-based, so they are given as term_defs (ref_torso_*) rather than the runner's root-based ref_root_* terms.
isaac.self_collision: mjlab's own G1 collision configuration is not vendored in the repo; on/off for specific pairs unverified.

obs_history.layout: tensor [1,10,167]; row k = full 167-D obs frame at tick k-9 (oldest first, last row = current obs, identical to 'obs'); on reset all 10 rows = first obs

ref_torso_ori_6d_rel.definition: R = R(q_robot_torso_w)^T R(q_ref_torso_w) where torso quats come from FK (robot: pelvis world quat + measured joints with zero base pos; ref: yaw-aligned ref root pose + ref joints); 6d = R[:, :2] flattened row-major = [r00, r01, r10, r11, r20, r21] (first two COLUMNS)

ref_torso_lin_vel_in_robot_torso.frame: robot torso_link body frame (full 3D rotation by inverse of robot torso world quat)
ref_torso_lin_vel_in_robot_torso.definition: v = R(q_robot_torso_w)^T * v_ref_torso_w; deploy v_ref_torso_w = (p_ref_torso(t) - p_ref_torso(t-1)) * 50 from FK of consecutive yaw-aligned reference frames; 0 on the first step

ref_torso_ang_vel_in_robot_torso.definition: w = R(q_robot_torso_w)^T * w_ref_torso_w; deploy w_ref_torso_w = axis*angle of q_ref_torso(t) * q_ref_torso(t-1)^-1 (w made >=0) divided by 0.02; 0 on first step

ref_torso_height.definition: z of reference torso_link origin from FK of the yaw-aligned reference root pose + joints (world ground at z=0)

term_notes.ref_joint_pos: absolute reference joint angles (not minus default) teleopit/controllers/observation.py:198,205
term_notes.ref_joint_vel: deploy: finite difference of consecutive reference joint pos * 50 Hz (runtime_components.py:265-279)
term_notes.base_ang_vel: gyro at site imu_in_pelvis (pelvis body frame), no scale teleopit/robots/mujoco_robot.py:184-200
term_notes.last_action: raw network output of the previous control step (before clip/scale); zeros at reset (runtime_components.py:96-97,323-325)

trained_in.value: MuJoCo Warp via mjlab==1.4.0 (General-Tracking-G1 task, rsl_rl PPO with TemporalCNN actor)

actuator_model.value: implicit PD: mjlab G1 robot cfg (get_g1_robot_cfg, mjlab built-in position actuators: force = kp*(q*-q) - kd*qd, effort-limited) - deploy mirrors it with MuJoCo built-in PD (gainprm=kp, biasprm=[0,-kp,-kd]). No action delay, no obs latency, no action filtering in training; DR = push, base COM offset (torso), joint default pos +-0.01, geom friction 0.3-1.6, pseudo-inertia (torso, wrists), obs noise (U ranges).

velocity_limit.note: no joint velocity limit is set anywhere in the repo code (mjlab G1 actuator cfg not vendored; deploy does not clip velocity)

self_collision.value: likely on: G1 MJCF collision class capsules use MuJoCo default contype=conaffinity=1, and training adds a self_collision ContactSensor (primary all bodies except wrist_yaw links, secondary pelvis subtree) with a -0.1 penalty reward; whether mjlab's G1 collision cfg (not vendored) disables some pairs is unknown

default_root_height.note: pelvis z at reset in deploy; training resets to the reference motion pose (+ pose_range noise)

terrain_friction.value: flat plane only; robot collision-geom friction randomized absolute U(0.3,1.6) at startup (geoms matching .*_collision); foot capsules friction 0.6 in XML

hands.value: track_g1: fixed rubber hands (visual mesh + one capsule collision per hand on wrist_yaw_link, no hand DoF). track_g1_neck_o6: fixed LinkerHand O6 hands + neck camera module as rigid bodies (g1_29dof_neck_o6.xml), still 29 DoF

teleop_reference.value: bundled GMR (General Motion Retargeting, IK) maps BVH (offline/UDP) or Pico 4 full-body tracking (pico_bridge, human_format pico_bridge) to a 36-D G1 qpos per input frame; reference then yaw-aligned to the robot and finite-differenced for velocities

realtime_lookahead.value: 0 future frames (reference_steps [0]); live stream is buffered (0.5 s window) and sampled with one input-frame delay (retarget_buffer_delay_s null = auto), interpolated to 50 Hz; nothing needs to be faked

deploy_rate.value: policy 50 Hz, PD/sim 200 Hz (sim2sim); real robot via Unitree lowcmd at the same 50 Hz policy rate

measured.how: onnx.load graph + onnxruntime CPU, 1 thread, batch 1, random inputs, 200 runs on the dev laptop (2026-11-03). TorchScript archives are not loaded; params estimated from tensor blobs.
